fixesOpened.title: Group invites no longer error when the app is still signing in
fixesOpened.whatItFixes: Fixes PostHog “permission denied for table group_invites” (6 events / 3 people, builds 36–39): a brief signed-out request at launch was refused. Now that request may read invites; row rules still only show your own invites. Database change only, no app update needed.
fixesOpened.howToCheck: Sign in as a tester, get invited to a group, force-quit and reopen, open Groups and Activity: pending invites show and Join/Decline work. After it’s on prod, group_action_failed should stop showing this error.
